rationale: After 42 minutes in the trade, upward momentum has failed to materialize with a maximum favorable excursion of only 0.14%. Price has now slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($14.25), and the most recent 1-minute candles show consecutive lower lows accompanied by increasing volume on the downside. With two key components of the entry thesis—holding the 9-EMA and rising buy volume on higher lows—no longer intact, closing the position early mitigates the risk of a deeper pullback toward VWAP.
